methods.name: ORCA
methods.description: Optimal Reciprocal Collision Avoidance, an efficient navigation planner providing theoretical non-collision guarantees under certain conditions.

methods.name: SA-CADRL
methods.description: Socially aware collision avoidance with deep reinforcement learning, formulated as a cooperative multi-agent collision avoidance problem.

methods.name: Social Forces
methods.description: An early influential work on modeling pedestrian navigation that represents pedestrian navigation behavior under the influence of 'social forces' including an attractive force to their goal, a repulsive force from other pedestrians and obstacles, and other attractive forces to interesting objects or other pedestrians in the environment.

methods.name: meta-planner
methods.description: plans a sub-goal within a 6-second horizon each time a new checkpoint is requested; uses a 3D unicycle model without kinematic constraint application when used as a meta-planner.

methods.name: social navigation formulation
methods.description: formulates social navigation as a cooperative multi-agent collision avoidance problem with well-crafted rules to inject social awareness

methods.name: network configuration
methods.description: uses the 4-agent version of the network, taking observations from the three nearest pedestrians to the robot

methods.name: meta-level planner implementation
methods.description: implements a meta-level planner for ORCA and CADRL, which samples trajectories from a connectivity graph and evaluates them via heuristic cost functions
